title: Help Them with External Triggers
coreMove: Help a child spot the cue that pulls them off plan and change the environment with them instead of policing every lapse.
sourcePressure: The child section applies external-trigger shaping with adult scaffolding, helping children notice and change cues in their environment.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: A weak run would hide every device or blame platforms without teaching cue awareness.

hook: Help Them with External Triggers as a labeled topic opener
counterintuition: phones are not the problem by itself
tryThisNow: set a timer and notice your distractions
examples: reused old-package object-anchor shell from earlier Indistractable run

exampleSpecs.domain: young gymnast distracted by trophy-shelf videos during homework
exampleSpecs.stakes: homework starts with comparison if the cue stays in view
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the child points to the tablet stand under the trophy shelf and moves it to the practice bag
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A silver meet medal hangs above an empty tablet stand.

exampleSpecs.domain: teen drummer pulled by band-chat pings during study
exampleSpecs.stakes: practice coordination matters, but pings during study do not
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: they create a band-chat focus rule and choose the drum keychain as the after-study cue
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A drum keychain sits beside a muted band-chat screen.

exampleSpecs.domain: child reader abandoning books when game cartridges sit beside the bed
exampleSpecs.audience: parent shaping the room with the child
exampleSpecs.stakes: reading time needs fewer visual bids
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: before, cartridges sit in reach; after, the child puts a library bookmark where the cartridges were
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A library bookmark lies where a cartridge case used to sit.

exampleSpecs.domain: young baker distracted by recipe video suggestions
exampleSpecs.audience: grandparent helping keep one recipe visible
exampleSpecs.stakes: the child can learn cooking without wandering into videos
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: they print the recipe card and close the video site before measuring flour
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A printed muffin recipe is clipped above a flour scale.

exampleSpecs.domain: teen lifeguard trainee checking messages during CPR study
exampleSpecs.audience: instructor helping the teen identify cues
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the teen notices buzzes from the towel pocket and places the phone in a locker before the next drill
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A CPR manikin face shield rests beside a locker tag.

exampleSpecs.domain: child drawing comics while notifications pop on a shared tablet
exampleSpecs.stakes: the drawing block loses flow when app badges stay visible
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the child chooses drawing-only mode and covers the home screen with the sketch app
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A panel sketch page sits beneath a drawing-only tablet screen.
